page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 244. Main text in one column of prose and verse. Hymn in two parallel verse columns (left and right) below the heading "AD HORAS CANONICAS". Then heading "IN TRANSLATIONE S. Martini" and verse lines. Catchword "Cæcis" at the lower right.

main_text.p: viribus suspensus, terrena cuncta respuit. Ejus ori nunquam Christus defuit, sive inscientiâ, vel quicquid ad veram vitam pertinet. Igitur te cuncti poscimus ô Martine, ut qui multa mira hic ostendisti, etiam de cœlo gratiam Christi supplicatu tuo semper infundas. Amen.
main_text.head: DE EODEM:
main_text.p: Martinus quoniam vota fidelium attendit, tribuens cuncta salubria, confert hic famulis, rite canentibus, stellis aureola ferra micantibus
main_text.head: AD HORAS CANONICAS, IN EIUS solennitate hymnus.
main_text.l: Martinus autem prævius, | Hic nos per undas seculi
Fac ut sit horis omnibus, | Clavo gubernet prospero,
Ne Dæmonum fallacia | Ne forte nostram spumea
Pes nostcr intactus ruat. | Puppim charybdis sorbeat.
Hic arma nobis cœlica, | Hic nos triumpho nobili,
Instante pugna conferat, | Et laureatos mystice,
Hoc praliante cominus | Aptet tuis conspectibus,
Hostis fugetur noxius. | Junctos supernis civibus.
main_text.head: IN TRANSLATIONE S. Martini.
main_text.p: Nos audi, tua festa colentes annua mundo celebria.
Tu pro nobis, spes nostra, Martine, Deo supplica.

page.notes: Verse columns are parallel; the left column is read first. Some letters in the hymn and the first lines are smudged or uncertain. The short line "Cæcis" is the catchword at the foot. Hymn heading is in italic.
